verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a Teams feature for creating a team, inviting members, and assigning them roles. It also documents scoped API keys with limited permissions via `vastai create api-key`, recommended for CI/CD and shared tooling. Together these cover the core of the story, but the depth of the role model and any spend controls are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented role/permission granularity, per-member or per-key spend limits or budget controls, key revocation/audit details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
